# Optional review request form

Use for an explicitly authorized review. Supply current issue/specification and diff; historical plans are inputs only when this review depends on them.

- GitHub issue / accepted specification:
- Baseline and reviewed diff/commit:
- Expected outcome and affected boundaries:
- Relevant contract/ADR links:
- Completed checks and evidence locations:
- Known risks, gaps or areas requiring attention:
- Requested findings-first output and scope of review:

[Rules](../development/rules.md) owns authorization/commits, [quality](../development/quality.md) owns verification, and the [tracker](../agents/issue-tracker.md) owns task state. Use relevant fields; the form adds no approval gate or mandatory report.
